inputs.description: Canal de release pour l'ISO Slura

tasks.label: make: ESP dirs
args: $e = '${workspaceFolder}\slr_clk_bt\x64\amd64\esp'; $s = "$e\SDC\slu64"; @("$e\EFI\BOOT","$e\sources","$e\boot\assets\font","$e\boot\font","$s\assets\fonts","$s\assets\crypto","$s\contracts","$s\DrivRequirment","$s\env","$s\chain\pending_txs","$s\chain\calls","$s\chain\receipts","$s\chain\state\balances","$s\chain\metadata","$s\apps\ShiLauncher\ShiLauncher.slasset") | ForEach-Item { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $_ | Out-Null }; Remove-Item -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue "$e\efiboot.img", "$e\sources\install.slin"; Write-Host 'ESP dirs OK (efiboot.img + install.slin nettoyes)'

tasks.label: install: EncDecProcManSrv → apps SRFS
args: $src = '${workspaceFolder}\slr_clk_bt\EncDecProcManSrv.marep'; $dst = '${workspaceFolder}\slr_clk_bt\x64\amd64\esp\SDC\slu64\apps\EncDecProcManSrv'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force "$dst\EncDecProcManSrv.slasset" | Out-Null; Copy-Item -Force "$src\Maraset.yaml" "$dst\Maraset.yaml"; if (Test-Path "$src\EncDecProcManSrv.slasset") { Copy-Item -Force -Recurse "$src\EncDecProcManSrv.slasset\*" "$dst\EncDecProcManSrv.slasset" }; Write-Host 'EncDecProcManSrv installe -> apps/EncDecProcManSrv'

tasks.label: install: SluWWANManSrv → apps SRFS
args: $src = '${workspaceFolder}\slr_clk_bt\SluWWANManSrv.marep'; $dst = '${workspaceFolder}\slr_clk_bt\x64\amd64\esp\SDC\slu64\apps\SluWWANManSrv'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force "$dst\SluWWANManSrv.slasset" | Out-Null; Copy-Item -Force "$src\Maraset.yaml" "$dst\Maraset.yaml"; if (Test-Path "$src\SluWWANManSrv.slasset") { Copy-Item -Force -Recurse "$src\SluWWANManSrv.slasset\*" "$dst\SluWWANManSrv.slasset" }; Write-Host 'SluWWANManSrv installe -> apps/SluWWANManSrv'

tasks.label: copy: ShiLauncher.slasset → SRFS
args: $src = '${workspaceFolder}\slr_clk_bt\ShiLauncher.marep\ShiLauncher.slasset'; $dst = '${workspaceFolder}\slr_clk_bt\x64\amd64\esp\SDC\slu64\apps\ShiLauncher\ShiLauncher.slasset'; if (Test-Path $src) { Copy-Item -Force -Recurse "$src\*" $dst; Write-Host "ShiLauncher.slasset → SRFS OK" } else { Write-Warning "ShiLauncher.slasset introuvable: $src" }

tasks.label: install: ShiLooker → apps SRFS
args: $src = '${workspaceFolder}\slr_clk_bt\ShiLooker.marep'; $dst = '${workspaceFolder}\slr_clk_bt\x64\amd64\esp\SDC\slu64\apps\ShiLooker'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force "$dst\ShiLooker.slasset" | Out-Null; Copy-Item -Force "$src\Maraset.yaml" "$dst\Maraset.yaml"; if (Test-Path "$src\ShiLooker.slasset") { Copy-Item -Force -Recurse "$src\ShiLooker.slasset\*" "$dst\ShiLooker.slasset" }; Write-Host 'ShiLooker installe → apps/ShiLooker'

tasks.label: install: TestApp → apps SRFS
args: $src = '${workspaceFolder}\slr_clk_bt\TestApp.marep'; $dst = '${workspaceFolder}\slr_clk_bt\x64\amd64\esp\SDC\slu64\apps\TestApp'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force "$dst\TestApp.slasset" | Out-Null; Copy-Item -Force "$src\Maraset.yaml" "$dst\Maraset.yaml"; if (Test-Path "$src\TestApp.slasset") { Copy-Item -Force -Recurse "$src\TestApp.slasset\*" "$dst\TestApp.slasset" }; Write-Host 'TestApp installe → apps/TestApp'

tasks.label: marai build: Vmwaretool.marep
args: Remove-Item -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue '${workspaceFolder}\slr_clk_bt\x64\amd64\vmwaretool_cd'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force '${workspaceFolder}\slr_clk_bt\x64\amd64\vmwaretool_cd\SDC\slu64\apps\Vmwaretool\Vmwaretool.slasset' | Out-Null; marai build Vmwaretool.marep -O --arch=x64 "--out-dir=${workspaceFolder}\slr_clk_bt\x64\amd64\vmwaretool_cd"

tasks.label: stage: Vmwaretool → CD layout
args: $src = '${workspaceFolder}\slr_clk_bt\Vmwaretool.marep'; $dst = '${workspaceFolder}\slr_clk_bt\x64\amd64\vmwaretool_cd\SDC\slu64\apps\Vmwaretool'; Copy-Item -Force "$src\Maraset.yaml" "$dst\Maraset.yaml"; Copy-Item -Force -Recurse "$src\Vmwaretool.slasset\*" "$dst\Vmwaretool.slasset"; Write-Host 'Vmwaretool → CD layout OK'

tasks.label: make: vmwaretool.iso
args: & 'D:\msys64\usr\bin\xorriso.exe' -as mkisofs -V VMWARETOOL -R -J -joliet-long -iso-level 3 -o vmwaretool.iso 'slr_clk_bt/x64/amd64/vmwaretool_cd'; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Write-Error 'xorriso a echoue'; exit 1 }; Write-Host '[ISO] OK -> vmwaretool.iso'

tasks.label: copy: all drivers → SRFS DrivRequirment
args: $dst = '${workspaceFolder}\slr_clk_bt\x64\amd64\esp\SDC\slu64\DrivRequirment'; $src = '${workspaceFolder}\slr_clk_bt\x64\amd64\esp\sources'; @('SluGpu.slul','SluHIIDMan.slul','SluFontConf.slul','SRFSMan.slul','NTFSMan.slul','SluDskMan.slul','SluWWANMan.slul','SluEnvSys.slul','CryptoAssetSupport.slul','EncDecProcMan.slul','SluPwMan.slul') | ForEach-Object { Copy-Item -Force "$src\$_" $dst }; Write-Host '11 drivers → DrivRequirment OK'

tasks.label: marai image: create install.slin
args: Remove-Item -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue '${workspaceFolder}\slr_clk_bt\x64\amd64\esp\sources\install.slin'; marai slin create "${workspaceFolder}\slr_clk_bt\x64\amd64\esp" --out "${workspaceFolder}\slr_clk_bt\x64\amd64\install.slin.tmp" --name "Slura OS" --os-version "1.0.0" --arch x64

tasks.label: marai slin: apply install.slin → installed
args: $target = '${workspaceFolder}\slr_clk_bt\x64\amd64\installed\esp'; $slin = '${workspaceFolder}\slr_clk_bt\x64\amd64\esp\sources\install.slin'; if (Test-Path $target) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $target }; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $target | Out-Null; marai slin apply $slin $target; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Write-Error 'marai slin apply a echoue'; exit 1 }; $ntfs = Join-Path $target 'SDC\slu64\DrivRequirment\NTFSMan.slul'; $srfs = Join-Path $target 'SDC\slu64\DrivRequirment\SRFSMan.slul'; $missing = @(); if (-not (Test-Path $ntfs)) { $missing += 'NTFSMan.slul' }; if (-not (Test-Path $srfs)) { $missing += 'SRFSMan.slul' }; if ($missing.Count -gt 0) { Write-Error "Driver(s) manquant(s) dans l'image installee : $($missing -join ', ')"; exit 1 }; Write-Host "OK - install.slin applique vers $target (NTFSMan.slul + SRFSMan.slul confirmes presents)"

tasks.label: make: booter.iso
args: $stamp = Get-Date -Format 'ddMMyyHH'; $rawChannel = '${input:releaseChannel}'; if ($rawChannel -match '^[a-z]+$') { $channel = $rawChannel } else { $channel = 'dev' }; $isoName = "Slura1_NAVERTA_${channel}_build${stamp}.iso"; Write-Host "[ISO] $isoName"; Remove-Item -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue '${workspaceFolder}\slr_clk_bt\x64\amd64\esp\efiboot.img'; Write-Host '[ISO] building efiboot.img (FAT ESP image, via WSL mkfs.vfat) ...'; wsl -u root -e bash -lc 'set -e; rm -f /tmp/efiboot.img /mnt/d/Downloads/Vyft_product/Slura/slr_clk_bt/x64/amd64/esp/efiboot.img; dd if=/dev/zero of=/tmp/efiboot.img bs=1M count=512 status=none; mkfs.vfat -F 32 -n SLURA_ESP /tmp/efiboot.img >/dev/null 2>&1; mkdir -p /tmp/efimnt; mount -o loop /tmp/efiboot.img /tmp/efimnt; cp -r /mnt/d/Downloads/Vyft_product/Slura/slr_clk_bt/x64/amd64/esp/. /tmp/efimnt/; sync; umount /tmp/efimnt; cp /tmp/efiboot.img /mnt/d/Downloads/Vyft_product/Slura/slr_clk_bt/x64/amd64/esp/efiboot.img'; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Write-Error 'efiboot.img (WSL) a echoue'; exit 1 }; & 'D:\msys64\usr\bin\xorriso.exe' -as mkisofs -V SLURA_PARTDISK -R -J -joliet-long -iso-level 3 -eltorito-alt-boot -e 'efiboot.img' -no-emul-boot -isohybrid-gpt-basdat -o $isoName 'slr_clk_bt/x64/amd64/esp'; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Write-Error 'xorriso a echoue'; exit 1 }; Write-Host "[ISO] OK -> $isoName"

tasks.label: 6️⃣ vmware: run UEFI test
args: $iso = Get-ChildItem -Path '${workspaceFolder}' -Filter 'Slura1_NAVERTA_*.iso' | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $iso) { Write-Error 'Aucun ISO Slura1_NAVERTA_*.iso trouve — lance make: booter.iso d''abord'; exit 1 }; Write-Host "[VMware] ISO le plus recent : $($iso.Name)"; $vmx = '${workspaceFolder}\VyftUEFI.vmx'; (Get-Content $vmx) -replace '^ide1:0\.fileName\s*=.*$', "ide1:0.fileName = `"$($iso.Name)`"" | Set-Content -Path $vmx -Encoding ASCII; Write-Host "[VMware] VyftUEFI.vmx -> $($iso.Name)"; & 'C:\Program Files (x86)\VMware\VMware Workstation\vmrun.exe' -T ws start $vmx nogui; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Write-Error 'vmrun a echoue'; exit 1 }

tasks.label: 🧪 build + test jalon1 fenetres (kernel + ShiLauncher + ShiLooker)
🌐 Full Slura + Platform Engine (kernel + blockchain + ISO)
make: booter.iso
